narr: A line of severe thunderstorms swept across the western Nebraska Panhandle during the late afternoon and early evening hours on 5/9, primarily producing damaging straight line winds. A separate round of isolated storms impacted the same areas during the late evening and overnight hours into 5/10, with numerous reports of hail and flash flooding in and around Scottsbluff and Gering.
ev: Numerous reports of significant street flooding in and around Scottsbluff and Gering. Water was reportedly entering some homes.
lsr: NUMEROUS REPORTS OF SIGNIFICANT STREET FLOODING IN/AROUND SCOTTSBLUFF AND GERING. WATER REPORTEDLY ENTERING SOME HOMES.
